_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#3. A 1-element HEX8 deck that exits 0 is given, in turn, three section names the catalogue calls out as wrong. All three abort with the offending name quoted: "Section 'EVERY_ITERATION' is not a valid section name.", the same for the transposed 'DESIGN THERMO LINE DIRICH CONDITIONS', and the same for 'DESIGN FLUID LINE LIFT&DRAG' — all from core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp line 546. A fourth arm distinguishes the neighbouring failure: the real section IO carrying a key it does not own ('BANANA') gives 'Could not match this input' from 4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp line 633 and never blames the section NAME (BADKEY_BLAMED_THE_SECTION_NAME=0). The binary's own schema is then queried for the same names: 'DESIGN LINE THERMO DIRICH CONDITIONS' is present (1), the transposed spelling is absent (0), LIFT&DRAG exists as SURF (1) and not as LINE (0), EVERY_ITERATION is absent (0), and the schema declares 251 DESIGN sections in total. Sections appear in the dump as '    - name: <NAME>' under the top-level 'sections:' key, which is why the plain 'grep DESIGN' recipe needs that prefix. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'EVERY_ITERATION' is not a valid section name.
Section 'DESIGN THERMO LINE DIRICH CONDITIONS' is not a valid section name.
Section 'DESIGN FLUID LINE LIFT&DRAG' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the transposed arm: write the spelling the schema actually declares. That arm then runs to completion, the section-name diagnostic vanishes, and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the EVERY_ITERATION arm: drop the invented section. That arm exits 0 and the fixture must go red.
